text:
anya: Quick sync — finalizing rollout plan for routes.payment.v2. Customer-driven launch (B2B payments) with tiered cutover windows. Need ops slots + auto-rollback thresholds. 
kevin: +1. Can we keep initial canary in one AZ (us-west-2) then a regional ramp?
anya: Proposal: 3-phase ramp across regions: 1) canary us-west only (1% traffic) for 1 hour, 2) regional warmup us-west + us-east (5%) for 6 hours, 3) full region ramp to 25% then 100% over 48h.
marcus: We should codify abort criteria. Suggest auto-rollback if: error-rate > 2x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency increases > 200ms for 5m. Also immediate rollback if any customer-visible 5xx spike (>0.5% of requests).
jordan: For A/B measurement we need a secondary signal: success_rate and NPS-ish proxy. I'll hook up the payment success metric and conversion delta. Want 95% CI on key metric before >25% ramp.
linda: Sales asks — some customers on platinum need early opt-in. We should support per-tenant opt-in flags + a blackout opt-out window (24h notice).
anya: Agreed. Plan includes a per-tenant opt-in list. Default flow: off for everyone, plus a controlled opt-in cohort.
kevin: Implementation notes: we'll use feature-flag service with rollout weights per region and per-tenant overrides. Example flag payload: 
```json
{ "flag": "routes.payment.v2_enabled", "strategies": [ {"scope": "region", "region": "us-west-2", "pct": 1}, {"scope": "region", "region": "us-east-1", "pct": 0}, {"scope": "tenant", "tenant_id": "T-PLAT-123", "pct": 100} ], "kill_conditions": {"error_rate_mult": 2.0, "p95_ms": 200} }
```
marcus: Ops slots: request two dedicated 2-hour windows during week 1 for manual watch and fast rollback (09:00-11:00 PT and 14:00-16:00 PT). Include pager escalation to oncall and product-runbook link.
anya: Runbook id: RB-2026-42 (I'll create). Add automated postmortem trigger if rollback occurs.
kevin: Fallback policy: on auto-rollback, route to routes.payment.v1 (stable) and to quantized model variant for read-only flows. Also mark the flag state as "failed-canary" to prevent auto-reroll for 24h.
jordan: For A/B traffic split we want to run a 2-week experiment for non-payment funnels (search & cart) at 15% vs control, to catch regressions in downstream flows. Keep experiment tags in telemetry.
linda: Can we give customers a manual "pause" button in the admin console to opt-out of v2 if they see issues?
kevin: Yes — per-tenant override is trivial; we'll add UI flag and API. Need product + security sign-off for that UI change.
marcus: Preflight checklist (ops): 
- smoke test suite green (local & canary)
- observability dashboards created (error-rate, latency P50/95/99, success-rate, user-visible failures)
- alert thresholds mapped to runbook
- rollout inhibit if infra CPU/GPU utilization >80%

anya: Launch gating (must pass before phase 2): low-severity errors <= baseline, p95 within 1.2x baseline, no customer escalations, experiment telemetry fine.
kevin: TL;DR rollout timeline: Day 0: canary (1h), Day 0-1: regional warmup (6h), Day 1-3: staged ramp to 25%, Day 3-5: full ramp if metrics stable.
anya: Who owns the go/no-go in each window? Ops owns canary; product + eng own regional ramp decision. We need designated approvers for each ops slot.
linda: I'll consolidate the platinum early-adopter list and send final CSV by EOD.
jordan: I'll publish the experiment dashboard and add the CI check to block >25% if samples insufficient.
marcus: I'll add automation to flip flag to fallback on specified kill_conditions and post to #incidents via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Note: automated rollback configured once kill_conditions are enabled. Will notify channel on state changes. :robot_face: 
anya: Great. Next steps: I will create RB-2026-42 runbook, kevin will submit feature-flag PR, marcus will confirm alerts + automation, jordan will wire experiment metrics, linda will deliver CSV. Aim to start canary on Fri 09:00 PT.
kevin: I'll have PR up by tomorrow AM.
marcus: Adding alerts now.
anya: Thanks all — posting this as the canonical plan. If anything else, ping me in-thread. :white_check_mark:
